invariants.statement: A blocked warrant claims the sender is waiting.
A blocked warrant claims nothing of anyone but the sender.
An announced message claims nothing of the sender.
An announce is not a reason for its sender to keep running.
The answer to a blocked message reaches the sender's mailbox.

invariants.statement: Archiving and skipping exclude each other.
Skipping is doing nothing to the mail rather than leaving the filing unstated.

invariants.statement: A clause with several values passes where a value matches.

invariants.statement: A field is named as the mail has that field rather than as its own page is slugged.
Every field here has text.
Every field takes the same comparisons.
A field the mail offers sits here whether or not a rule names that field yet.

value.definition: the sort of balance an account holds

invariants.statement: The sorts are Monarch's own words rather than words chosen here.
A sort Monarch spells with an underscore is kept as Monarch spells that sort.

value.definition: how a clause weighs what it tests against what it holds

invariants.statement: A clause with several values passes where a single value matches.
Only a clause testing a date compares by `on-or-after` or `is-before`.

value.definition: what about a transaction a clause tests

invariants.statement: A merchant is read through the merchant vocabulary rather than off the row.
A sign is `positive` where money came in and `negative` where money went out.
An account is tested by the last four digits its slug ends in.

value.definition: which way money runs through a category's group

invariants.statement: A transfer moves money the household already holds from one account to another.

value.definition: what settled a transaction's category

invariants.statement: A source that is not Monarch holds against the category Monarch reports.
A transaction stating no source took its category from Monarch untouched.

value.definition: whether a group draws its readings in label order or in place order

invariants.statement: A group stating nothing draws in label order.
Two readings sharing one place draw in label order between the two.

value.definition: whether a reading is drawn as a stoplight or as a bare number

invariants.statement: A readout stating nothing is drawn as a stoplight.
A reading drawn as a number is drawn without a rung behind the figure.

value.definition: how grown-up the provider says a series is

invariants.statement: A rating is the provider's judgement rather than Alan's.

value.definition: what an argument carries after the way that argument is spelled

invariants.statement: An argument carrying no value is said and nothing follows it.
A path is read against the repository root and whether it must land inside belongs to the command.
No value here is a body piped in.

invariants.statement: An entry stating nothing here is filled at its flag.
An argument filled as a word alone is not taken at its flag.
A refusal names an argument filled as a word alone by its placeholder.
Words fill the arguments taken as words in the order the page states them.
How a call fills an argument belongs to the command rather than to the argument.
